# A Provider formula never re-runs for a key absent at its first run

Standalone core ticket, referenced by #18605 (OQ8's engine half in D#18594). Not a leaf: it stands on its own and #18605's published-truth leaf seeds around it regardless. `Decision Record impact: none`.

`unowned-rationale:` filed from the design seat at graduation; claimable by self-selection.

## Context

Measured in D#18594's receipt (arm 7 of `DockReactiveSurface.scratch.spec.mjs` at `dev@28e56e1543`, 10/10), with a prediction falsified on the way — which is why the boundary below is precise.

## The Problem

`Neo.state.Provider` runs a formula as a lazy Effect once in `onConstructed`. A formula that reads `data.dock.perspective.active` while `data.dock` does not exist registers **no** dependency (there is no proxy parent to track), and when `setData('dock.perspective', {...})` later creates the key, only the binding effects re-run (`src/state/Provider.mjs` `#bindingEffects`, `:196–199`; the new-key path around `:451`/`:875` — verify the lines at claim). The formula's target keeps its first value forever.

The boundary, measured: a formula reading an absent **leaf** under a seeded **parent** *does* re-run, because the parent object is rewritten by bubbling; only an absent top-level key (or absent ancestor) is dead.

## The Architectural Reality

Proxy reads register the leaf and every parent object on the path; `getData(path)` is exact-leaf; `setData` on a namespace merges. The dependency graph has nothing to attach a read of a non-existent ancestor to.

## The Fix

Either (a) re-run formula effects on new top-level key creation the way binding effects re-run, or (b) let the proxy record reads of absent keys as dependencies (a "missed read" set per Effect) and re-run when the key appears. (b) is the general fix; (a) is the one-line one. The docblock on `formulas` states the semantics either way.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Unit spec: a provider with `formulas: {x: data => data.a?.b}` constructed without `a`; `setData('a.b', 1)` after construction re-runs the formula and its bound target updates; the same for `setData('a', {b: 1})`.
- [ ] The existing Provider suite stays green; no double-run of formulas on ordinary leaf writes.
- [ ] `formulas` docblock states when a formula re-runs.

## Out of Scope

The ownership rule (a formula on an ancestor provider never observes a descendant's publication) — that is documentation, carried by #18605's guides leaf.
